answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 62669 Country: Pakistan Title: IMMIGRATION Question: I have got the immigration of USA and got the green card. I am 58 years old and properly settled in Pakistan. I have the Canadian nationality also. I did not settle there. I am regularly praying namaz by jamat. I have good property and properly settled. Please let us know whether it is viable to migrate to America as per Islamic teaching or surrender it. Answer ID: 62669 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 159/159/B=03/1437) When you are residing in Pakistan which is a Muslim country where crores of other Muslims also live and chant the name of Allah, you should try to pass your life in Islamic atmosphere and this atmosphere may not be available in Canada or America. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
